title: Audit Claude Code health, skills and settings, then simplify
body:
Outcome: operator, verbatim (2026-11-01): "potem /doctor i wielkki audyt skillsów i ustawień, a na końcu potencjalnie /simplify". Run /doctor (operator types it, or krn doctor plus claude doctor output), audit every skill (project .claude/skills, .agents/skills, user ~/.claude/skills, plugins, skillOverrides) and settings (user, project, local, ~/.claude.json project entries) for dead, duplicate, contradictory or context-expensive entries; then /simplify on the changed code.
Proof: an audit file with findings and evidence; each fix merged or recorded as a task; measured first-turn context before and after.
